mintAuthority.summary: USTB has independently evidenced native issuance surfaces on Ethereum and Solana. The Ethereum issuer EOA controls the token proxy's direct mint path and ProxyAdmin, while the Solana Token-2022 mint has a live issuer mint authority held by a System Program-owned account. Plume is conservatively treated as an Ethereum-issued bridge representation: its owner-only mint/bulkMint and upgrade paths are reviewed as bridge-representation controls under bridgeRouteRisk because the evidence does not prove independent local Plume liabilities.

controls.label: USTB Solana Token-2022 mint authority
controls.capDescription: The finalized Token-2022 mint read returned live mintAuthority with supply 174,210.361163 USTB; no program or multisig cap was evidenced. The mint-authority account is System Program-owned. Solana freezeAuthority, permanent delegate, and default-frozen controls remain holder-transfer concerns in their owning risk review and are not part of native Mint Authority.

review.evidence: USTB has independently evidenced native issuance surfaces on Ethereum and Solana. Ethereum is an upgradeable token proxy whose issuer EOA owns both token and ProxyAdmin; Solana Token-2022 has live mintAuthority EfkJFKtVcpo8sgQGWLoaYcutxNdmqed81wdCcpn7egdz in finalized slot 439721950, with the authority account owned by the System Program. The Plume proxy is separately deployed and exposes owner-only mint/bulkMint, ProxyAdmin 0xa5df717b304a50838c72cd310c8df636b1aecfa3, and the same issuer EOA owner at block 87678057, but the evidence does not establish independent local liabilities rather than bridge destination issuance. Its bridge-mint, pause, peer-configuration, admin, and upgrade powers are therefore scored under bridgeRouteRisk. FreezeAuthority, permanent delegate, and default-frozen state remain outside Mint Authority. ORCHESTRATOR-AUTHORIZED adverse-pin correction — owner review required, verified 2026-10-20; original review start 2026-08-17 and all authority pins retained. The current USTB page names PwC as fund auditor but explicitly labels holdings unaudited; neither that page nor the current fund, smart-contract, NAV and security documentation supplies a dated recurring independent comparison of the complete Ethereum, Solana, Plume and book-entry liability book to backing. The security disclosure positively establishes overlapping ownership records at the calculation agent, internally and on-chain, and the balances API documents token, book-entry and protocol-share records by investor. These establish internal-ledger recordkeeping, not periodic whole-book reconciliation or attestation-only supervision. The original periodic/attestation-only assertion is withdrawn to internal-ledger/unknown; known unbounded issuer power is unchanged, and no reserve shortfall or absence of private audits is asserted.
